questions.question:
Find out the two signs to be interchanged to make the following equation correct.

25 + 25 × 25 − 25 ÷ 25 = −599
questions.solution:
A + and ×

Given expression: 25 + 25 × 25 − 25 ÷ 25 = −599

After replacing the symbols, we get:

L.H.S = 25 × 25 + 25 − 25 ÷ 25

= 625 + 25 – 1

= 650 – 1

= 649 ≠ R.H.S

B × and ÷

Given expression: 25 + 25 × 25 − 25 ÷ 25 = −599

After replacing the symbols, we get:

L.H.S = 25 + 25 ÷ 25

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term.

Ichthyology : Fishes :: Hematology : ?
questions.solution:
The logic is:

Ichthyology : Fishes → Ichthyology is the branch of Zoology that deals with fishes.

Similarly,

Hematology : ? → Hematology is the science or study of blood.

Hence, ‘Blood’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

36 : 324 :: 11 : ?
questions.solution:
The logic follows here is:

***First number *****×***** (sum of digits of 1st number) = 2nd number.***

36 : 324 → 36 × (3 + 6) = 324

Similarly,

11 : ? → 11 × (1 + 1) = 22

=> ? = 22

Hence,** ‘22’ **is the correct answer.

questions.question:
The statements below are followed by two conclusions labeled I and II. Assuming that the information in the statements is true, even if it appears at variance with generally established facts, decide which conclusion(s) logically and definitely follow(s) from the information given in the statements.

Statements:

1) All toads are frogs.

2) All frogs are snakes.

Conclusion:

I. Some snakes are toads.

II. Some frogs are toads.

options.text: Either conclusion I or conclusion II follows.

questions.solution:
*__Concept:__*

__
 
• Meaning of "Some A are B" in Syllogism - there is at least one point in A which is in B.
 
• Meaning of "All A are B" in Syllogism - each point of A is in B.
 
• This explains why "some" can be considered as a subset of "all".
 
• Therefore, *if "All A are B" is true, then "some A are B" is always true.*

***The least possible Venn diagram is:***__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/84bcb8b24271bd047528a39318102233194d0f43f49f63dbb35140809d27f640.png] 

I. Some snakes are toads. → True (as "all toads are frogs and all frogs are snakes" so some snakes are toads it is definite, hence, true)

II. Some frogs are toads. → True (as all toads are frongs given so some frogs are toads it is definite, hence, true)

Hence,** "Both conclusions follow" **is the correct answer.
